# WHOOP! WHOOP!

> WHOOP! WHOOP! is a free online memory card game where the matching rules change every round. It runs in any modern web browser on phones, tablets and computers, with no download, no account and no payment required.

WHOOP! WHOOP! is an independent card game. It is not affiliated with WHOOP, Inc. or the WHOOP fitness tracker.

The home page at https://whoop-whoop.com/ offers three ways to play:

- Daily: a new puzzle every day.
- Solo: play alone against the bot, FELIX.
- Together: live multiplayer for up to 6 players, joined by table code.

## The Daily

- A new puzzle every day, refreshing at local midnight.
- 9 face-down cards and 10 seconds to study them.
- 3 rounds; a die roll decides whether pairs match by shape, number or color.
- 2 misses allowed per round.
- Results can be shared, and streaks are tracked.

## The physical game

- 48 cards, plus one die that decides the matching rule.
- For 2 to 6 players, ages 7 and up.
- Race to be first to collect 12 cards.
- Full rules are online at https://whoop-whoop.com/rules.
